backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining a ContactRequest type and two public functions: submitContactForm to store contact submissions and getAllContactRequests to retrieve all stored requests.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the logo replacement feature with high confidence, referencing Navigation.tsx and multiple component dependencies.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing their purpose, from routing and layout components to forms, pages, hooks, and styling configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining design tokens for light and dark modes with neutral grays and teal/cyan accent colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx for the Easy2Contact application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router configuration defining five routes (home, services, about, contact, lead-generation) all wrapped in a shared Layout component.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Contact form component with name, email, company, and message fields that submits to the backend actor via React Query mutation and displays success feedback.
Three-column feature grid showcasing Lead Discovery, Data Intelligence, and Business Growth with icons and hover effects.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with company info, navigation links, services list, social media icons, and Caffeine.ai attribution with dynamic UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section with gradient teal/cyan background, value proposition headline, CTA buttons, and three statistics cards displaying key metrics.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout wrapper that renders Navigation header, main content outlet, and Footer for consistent page structure.
frontend/src/components/LeadGenerationFo: React form component for submitting lead generation requests with fields for name, email, company, and search criteria. Uses React Query mutations to submit data via the actor and displays success notifications.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Responsive navigation header component with desktop and mobile menu layouts, logo, navigation links, and a "Get Started" CTA button. Uses TanStack Router for navigation and highlights the active route.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Automatically creates authenticated or anonymous actors and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication on ICP. Manages login state, identity persistence, and provides login/logout functionality using the DFINITY AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Custom React Query hook that fetches all contact requests from the backend actor. Returns an empty array when the actor is not available or still loading.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors using OKLCH color space. Defines design tokens for backgrounds, foregrounds, borders, and component-specific colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component into the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: About page component displaying company mission, values (Accuracy, Customer Success, Innovation, Results), and statistics in a multi-section layout with hero banner and icon-based value cards.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Contact page component with hero section, contact information cards (email, phone, office address), business hours display, and embedded ContactForm component.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Homepage component featuring Hero, FeaturesSection, a 'Why Choose Us' section with three benefit cards (Verified Data, Instant Access, Expert Support), and a CTA section with link to lead generation.
frontend/src/pages/LeadGenerationPage.ts: Lead generation page with hero section, benefits grid explaining the process (Precise Targeting, Smart Filtering, Instant Results, Verified Contacts), LeadGenerationForm component, and a 'What You'll Receive' section describing deliverables.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: Services page displaying three service categories (Contact Data, Lead Generation, Business Intelligence) with feature lists, and three pricing packages (Starter, Professional, Enterprise) with feature comparisons.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color system using OKLCH color space, extended theme with teal/cyan color palettes, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting Easy2Contact website features, including homepage, services pages, contact forms, and a pending request to change the logo and restructure similar to bizprospex.com.
